name: the template unwritten is refused: its comments are not content
input:
<!-- The brief: what the unit lands and why. `mise run unit:check <n>` refuses the issue until every section below is written; a comment is not content. -->

## Sources

<!-- One line per source, marked primary (read whole, or the cited sections) or secondary: - `<library stem or design page>` — **primary**: <what it decides for this unit>. Include the vault's two listings. -->

## Readings

<!-- Answer every axis, a reason on both marks: `yes — <what the axis gives this unit>` or `no — <why it does not reach it>`. A bare `yes` or `no` is refused by `unit:check`. -->

| Family | Axis | Question | Selected |
| ------ | ---- | -------- | -------- |
| Identity | `univalent` | what univalence and the rewriting core give the construction: an equation, a transported rule, a replayed cell, representation independence | |
| Locality | `oracle` | which part is decided by certificate replay and which is computed; which modality or dominance classifies it | |
| Locality | `descent` | the local data, the interface, the assembly; what a change invalidates and reuses; the parallel width left | |
| Place | `located` | at which world a judgement or value is meaningful; what crosses worlds, and by what | |
| Place | `resident` | representation, sharing, persistence; where integrity stops and replay decides | |
| Dimension | `rewriting` | rules and normal forms; rewrites between rewrites; which coherence tier settles them | |
| Cost | `zero-cost` | what the change adds at run time and what demands it: a grade above zero, a crossing a located mode names or a branch a session type carries (then it is the program, not overhead), or a recipe policy off by default (then the artifact built without it carries none of its bytes and the checker refuses the forms that need it); what the grade erases; what a hand-written form would cost against it | |

## Concerns

<!-- Mark each concern of ledger/concerns.sql yes or no; a yes carries how: `yes — <how>`. -->

| Concern | Touched |
| ------- | ------- |
| `fork` | |
| `oracle` | |
| `sharing` | |

## Ledger

<!-- The features-ledger rows the unit lands, changes or retires, by id, or none. -->

## The shape

<!-- New territory only: the surface spelling, the obligation stated exactly, the fallback. Delete otherwise. -->

## Try first

<!-- New territory only: the probe that settles the open question. Delete otherwise. -->

## Not in this slice

<!-- The next unit on the lane. -->

## After

<!-- What this unit waits on: `none`, or one line per issue, `- #n — <what it waits for>`. `mise run unit:check --fix <n>` sets each as the issue's GitHub `blocked by` dependency; a dependency is never stated in prose. -->
